verdict_rule: hyp_cells.verdict: design fold fixes the sign; confirm fold decides. CONDITIONAL_POSITIVE = confirm mean > 0, t >= 2, design mean > 0; FAILED_VARIANT = confirm mean <= 0, or t < 2 with MDE <= effect worth having; else CANNOT_DISTINGUISH. SE over date blocks, MDE = 2.8 SE.

cells.title: Oil spike lifts oilfield services over integrated majors
cells.refutation: If the beta-adjusted spread is not significantly positive (t < 1), the differential read-through is refuted.
cells.separation_from_beta: The spread between oilfield services basket and integrated majors basket, beta-adjusted, should be positive after oil shock.

cells.title: Treasury yield shock lifts rate-sensitive homebuilders next session
cells.refutation: If the homebuilder basket's beta-adjusted return after yield shock is not significantly negative (t < 1), the read-through is refuted.
cells.separation_from_beta: Homebuilder basket's open-to-close return from t+1 to t+1 (or t+5) after removing market beta should be negative and significant.

cells.title: Oil shock -> refiners and chemicals (input cost) lag
cells.refutation: confirm-fold mean signed residual <= 0, or t < 2 with MDE below the design effect
cells.separation_from_beta: same-day beta printed apart; lag residual after SPY beta
